## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what a reviewer/user will see after this change.

## Validation

- Commands and actual results (test/corpus counts, tool versions, relevant flags).
- Independent numerical references and special/boundary cases, when applicable.
- Actual browser/device/theme checks or explicit visual-verification limitations.

## Evidence and generated files

Identify authoritative source changes and intentionally regenerated artifacts.
Include source hashes/conditions for hardware measurements. Preserve all existing
numerical/RTL tests; explain any unavailable fields or unsupported behavior.

## Documentation and licensing

Link updated contracts/guides. Attribute external public material under its own
terms; do not include proprietary designs or employer information. Separate
observations from causal hypotheses and physical results from synthesis estimates.

Publication, deployment, tagging and repository settings require separate explicit
maintainer authorization; this pull request does not authorize them automatically.
